CURE_CARRYING_THE_DISEASE.definition: a remedy whose own implementation instantiates the failure class it was written to prevent
CURE_CARRYING_THE_DISEASE.instance: the A315 extent gate: one environment variable converted the whole assertion into a stderr line — piped through tail in every invocation of the session — followed by a commit, and the artifact could not distinguish that commit from a fully asserted one. SILENT_EXTENT_LOSS inside the cure for SILENT_EXTENT_LOSS, at the first opportunity.
CURE_CARRYING_THE_DISEASE.binding_consequence_2: from here, any newly built gate is tested against its OWN failure class before it is trusted, and that test is one of A319's refusal demonstrations. Done for TIER_2 this node.

READ_IS_NOT_FIRED.statement: reading a check does not exercise it; only firing it does
READ_IS_NOT_FIRED.instances: the grep/sed/sort implementation would have refused every commit; clause 4 compared a set against itself and could never fire. Both survived writing and two readings. Both died on first attempt to fire.
READ_IS_NOT_FIRED.standing: where a check is cheap and firable, FIRE IT INSTEAD OF ARGUING — including against the owner's rulings. Promoted from coincidence to the programme's strongest working heuristic.
